model: Письменный стол двухтумбовый (Soviet double-pedestal writing desk)

top_dims.src: Festima.ru listing #230719471 (Moscow, solid-wood Soviet двухтумбовый, seller-measured 1395×700×730 mm) → rounds to 1400×700×730. GOST 26800.1-86 (administrative writing desks): height range 720–780 mm, work surface min 750×600 mm; width not GOST-mandated. 1400×700 is the repeatedly-cited canonical footprint for the type.

pedestal.src: Festima #230719471 (6 drawers, 3 per side, interior 340×500×90 mm); Tsiolkovsky Museum culture.ru/muzey_imeni_tsiolkovskogo/catalog/0002900023 ('по три ящика в каждой тумбе' — 3 drawers per pedestal on a classic двухтумбовый).

materials.top: Lacquered birch/oak veneer (massiv on higher-grade 1960s–early-70s; ЛДСП/ДСП wood-grain on later institutional), warm brown, polished
materials.handles: Metal bail/ring pulls (скобы) on solid-wood; recessed/plastic on ДСП
materials.knee: Knee recess open front-to-back, closed on the sides by the two pedestal carcasses; a shallow back apron rail under the top
materials.src: back-in-ussr.com/2015/11/sovetskaya-mebel.html (materials/polishing); Festima #230719471 (solid massiv, orgsteklo cover, 1972); Tsiolkovsky Museum culture.ru

derivation.note: DERIVED from the sourced numbers above (NOT independently sourced — the raw figures are in needs[]): pedestal_w = drawer_interior_w 340 + 2×18 mm carcass walls ≈ 376; knee = overall_w 1400 − 2×376 = 648; pedestal_d = top_d 700 − ~40 mm overhang ≈ 660; apron kept thin and high to stay above the GOST 26800.1-86 legroom minimum (610 mm floor-to-understructure).
derivation.src: geometric derivation from facts.top_dims + facts.pedestal + GOST 26800.1-86 legroom 610 mm
